summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing for ¿Quién va? MVP. 16/16 backend pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/logout/me/admin), events feed listing+sorting+filters (date+genre), admin CRUD (create/edit/delete), friends full flow (search→request→accept→list), Voy/Me interesa toggle (mutual exclusion + unmark + persistence), friend social proof + privacy (non-friends do NOT see interests), and friend_going notifications. Frontend Playwright flow verified: registration lands on /feed, 6 seeded events shown sorted by date, date filters (Hoy/Este finde/Prox semana/Todos) work, genre chips present, Voy/Me interesa toggle updates my_status correctly (voy→me_interesa→none), state persists after reload, empty-state message 'todavía ningún amigo se ha apuntado' visible, 'Conseguir entrada' vs 'Más información' shown correctly based on has_commission, friend search + send request works, admin login shows 'Panel de administración' button in Profile, /admin lists events, new event creation reflects in list, logout works and returns to /login.

integration_issues.flow: Unread notification badge in bottom nav
integration_issues.issue: nav-unread-badge relies on refetchInterval of 20s (AppShell.js:17). New notifications (friend_request/friend_going) are NOT reflected in the bell badge in real time; user must wait up to 20s or navigate to /notifications. Consider invalidating the 'unread-count' query on route changes or on websocket/polling with shorter interval, or invalidating whenever a friend action succeeds.

action_items: OPTIONAL: reduce unread-count refetchInterval or invalidate on relevant mutations so bell badge updates promptly (currently 20s delay).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py set_interest (line 582) uses existing['_id'] as filter which works because find_one didn't project it out — fine, but inconsistent with the rest of code that excludes _id. Consider using {'user_id':..., 'event_id':...} filter for consistency.
seed_admin overwrites role to 'admin' on every startup for the admin email; password is re-hashed only if plain password no longer verifies. Good behavior for the required credential rotation.

CORS allow_origins uses env var with fallback '*' but allow_credentials=True — with wildcard origins this is invalid per spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Since REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is same-origin (ingress-based), it works currently, but recommend setting explicit CORS_ORIGINS in production.
Password field for register has no minimum length validation server-side (accepts any string).
server.py is 835 lines (>700 threshold) — recommend splitting into routers/ modules (auth, events, friends, admin, notifications, storage).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows verified; only minor observation on badge refresh cadence)

test_credentials: Admin: admin@quienva.app / QuienVa2026! (verified). Register any new user via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed events (admin CRUD) and test_a_*/test_b_*/test_c_* users. No cleanup teardown — data is disposable/uniquely named per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend server at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Uses session_token cookie OR Authorization: Bearer <token>. Admin panel accessible from Profile page for admin role (data-testid=profile-admin-link). Voy/Me interesa mutual exclusion is enforced by single interests record per (user,event). Google OAuth NOT tested (external dependency). Weekly digest scheduler intentionally not implemented (per problem statement).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Minor UX gap on unread badge polling cadence (20s) noted.
